questions.question: Write an SQL query to show the first name and last name of all students in form 10B.

points.text: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Students WHERE Form = '10B'

questions.question: Write an SQL query to show all details of students whose last name starts with 'S', sorted by first name alphabetically.

points.text: SELECT * FROM Students WHERE LastName LIKE 'S%' ORDER BY FirstName ASC

questions.question: Write an SQL statement to insert a new student: StudentID 1007, Grace Lee, form 10A, year 10.

points.text: INSERT INTO Students (StudentID, FirstName, LastName, Form, YearGroup) VALUES (1007, 'Grace', 'Lee', '10A', 10)

questions.question: Write an SQL statement to change Bob Jones's form from 10B to 11B and his year group to 11.

points.text: UPDATE Students SET Form = '11B', YearGroup = 11 WHERE StudentID = 1002

questions.question: Write an SQL statement to delete all students in year group 11.

Full-Mark Response A table called Students has fields: StudentID, Name, TutorGroup, Grade. Write SQL statements to: (1) Show all students in tutor group '7B' with their names and grades. (2) Add a new student with ID 105, name 'Kai', tutor group '7B', grade 'B'. (3) Update the grade of student ID 105 to 'A'. [4 marks] <div class="

points.text: 1. SELECT Name, Grade FROM Students WHERE TutorGroup = '7B'; 2. INSERT INTO Students (StudentID, Name, TutorGroup, Grade) VALUES (105, 'Kai', '7B', 'B'); 3. UPDATE Students SET Grade = 'A' WHERE StudentID = 105; Note: Text values are enclosed in single quotes. The WHERE clause in the UPDATE ensures only student 105's grade is changed — without it, ALL students' grades would be updated to 'A'.
